notes: One equal-weight 3000-row cohort sampled from an explicit assumed transport law, not calibrated to inaccessible target estimates. Function uses the supplied seed and no sample recentering, reweighting, moment matching, seed selection or data access. Model describes final interview measured BP in a treatment-inclusive population; no restrictions on treatment, hypertension or HbA1c are applied or implicitly simulated as exclusions. Does not identify the target distribution from published summaries. Baseline age/BP versus subsequent laboratory sampling and unknown released final-reading aggregation remain measurement/selection limitations. Spec coefficients are conditional association-law settings, not guaranteed coefficients of the requested smaller OLS model, which omits quadratic age and age-sex interactions. Positive shifted-lognormal DBP and positive lognormal pulse pressure ensure SBP>DBP, permit high-pressure tails, and have finite relevant moments.

evidence_items.locator: Methods s2-1/s2-2 and s2-3-2; Results s3 opening paragraph, Tables 1-2

evidence_items.population: CRSN Heidelberg Aging Study, Nouna HDSS Burkina Faso, May-July 2018, age >=40. Final n=2114 (826 women,1288 men), partnered with relationship satisfaction data, not pregnant; excluded 101 reporting BP medication in prior 2 weeks and other missingness/outlier exclusions. Not the task population.
evidence_items.statistic_definition: Descriptive arithmetic means and SDs, not SEs. Unadjusted sex-specific summaries.
evidence_items.transfer: Do not transfer lean older covariate distribution or medication exclusion to target.
evidence_items.uncertainty: No CIs for these moments; age SD unknown in the read tables. Rounding means the reported pooled and sex-specific values need not be exactly algebraically consistent.

evidence_items.locator: abstract_001; Methods sec_002; Results sec_006 subsections S7-S11

evidence_items.locator: Methods; Results first four paragraphs and Figure 2 caption (read in full-text cursor 0-10000)
evidence_items.measurement: Automatic Omron three seated readings, mean readings 2 and 3; missing BP imputed using global data.
evidence_items.population: Brazil May Measurement Month 2018, opportunistic volunteers >=18; most common sites hospitals/clinics; not population representative, treatment included.
evidence_items.statistic_definition: Unweighted volunteer screening descriptive mean/SD and count; overweight and obese groups had higher SBP and DBP than healthy-weight category in regressions adjusted for age, sex and antihypertensive medication. Numeric figure contrasts not extracted.

omissions_and_limitations: Recognized search hit_0002_006 preview as a target-survey analysis; did not open it and excluded it from all evidence and parameter choices. Generic search had not intentionally requested target data.
Original relationship-satisfaction associations omitted because not part of task schema or necessary to requested projections.
Do not apply original medication, partnership, chronic-disease, or hypertension restrictions to target; do not infer laboratory eligibility from original paper.

The declared analytical population is approximated directly; there is no evidence-based propensity/selection model for laboratory completion, positive lab weights, retained unknown pregnancy, dictionary admissibility or complete-case conditioning.
Cannot assert national representativeness, empirical target calibration or identification. Repeated virtual rows are not new empirical evidence.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Row count, schema and population bounds prescribed by contract; integer baseline years chosen as plausible recording convention.
parameter_provenance.setting: n_rows=3000; columns=row_id,age,female,bmi,sbp,dbp; age 20..79 integer; row_id 1..3000; equal row weights

Source age/BMI-only projection derivation: R=[[1,-0.17],[-0.17,1]], u=[0.21,0.12], v=[0.02,0.16]; rho=(0.78-u R^-1 v')/sqrt((1-u R^-1 u')*(1-v R^-1 v')); approximately 0.787. Corresponding residual SDs 18.22*sqrt(1-u R^-1 u')≈17.6 and 10.98*sqrt(1-v R^-1 v')≈10.8 mmHg.
parameter_provenance.transfer: This is adjusted for age and BMI only, not sex. Exact task adjustment cannot be recovered without age variance and age-sex covariance. No confidence interval derived from rounded correlations.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Rounded association anchors. E3 gives 3.75 (95% CI 2.70,4.75) and 2.20 (1.55,2.85) per5 by multiplying by5 (DERIVED). E2 with age-only adjustment gives SBP 5*(18.22/3.9)*(0.12+0.17*0.21)/(1-0.17^2)≈3.75 and DBP 5*(10.98/3.9)*(0.16+0.17*0.02)/(1-0.17^2)≈2.37; sex not adjusted. Mexico approximate 3/4.5*5≈3.33 and 2/4.5*5≈2.22 per5, not exact extracted estimates.
parameter_provenance.transfer: Maintain approximately source BMI association when transported to inclusive adult population. No target evidence validates this; unmeasured confounding, BMI distribution, medication, geography and selection may change association. Not pooled as a formal meta-analysis.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Round derived source age/BMI-adjusted SDs and residual correlation above, transferring as conditional dispersion for measured BP. Not raw r=0.78 re-labelled.
parameter_provenance.transfer: Assume residual dependence largely persists under age/sex/BMI adjustment and in treatment-inclusive target. Treatment prevalence, cuff effects and unknown final reading aggregation could change all three. No target residual estimate used.

parameter_provenance.rationale: Younger-skewed adult age distribution and modest female enrichment with age; E5 provides broad Brazilian sex context only. No population representativeness assertion. No empirical identification of peso_lab/complete-case selection.
parameter_provenance.setting: Age bin masses [0.20,0.21,0.21,0.18,0.13,0.07] for 20-29,...,70-79; discrete uniform within each bin; P(female|age)=0.52+0.001*(age-20)

parameter_provenance.rationale: Higher adiposity than E1 is needed for plausible Latin-American adult context; younger distribution than volunteer E5 motivates lower overall mean. Midlife peak, larger female dispersion and modest female mean increment are physiological transport choices, not reported target facts. Lower shift13 avoids negative BMI; right-skew allows obesity tail, no upper truncation or sample rescaling.
parameter_provenance.setting: a=(age-50)/10; E[BMI|a,f]=26.5+0.8*f+0.6*a-0.25*a^2; conditional SD=4.3+1.0*f kg/m^2; BMI=13+shifted lognormal having these conditional moments

parameter_provenance.rationale: Baselines 128/82 at age50 male BMI25 chosen near source BP scale. SBP rising with age, DBP flattening/declining in later life, female difference narrowing with age are physiological assumptions supported qualitatively by E4 age patterns and E3 sex/age signs. E3 age and sex coefficients not directly transported due to age and treatment differences. No explicit treatment latent class; conditional means are assumed observed-pressure mixture rather than untreated natural pressures.

Shift30 mmHg for DBP and positive PP enforce physiological ordering. Lognormal conditional moment/covariance mapping is DERIVED algebra, not empirical evidence. All rows independent; within-person shared vascular tone and pulsatile load induce dependence. Fixed conditional variances, right-skew shapes and no rounding assumed; these do not establish actual released-reading aggregation.
parameter_provenance.setting: Joint law: D=30+L_D, PP=L_P, S=D+PP. Conditional means m_D=mu_D-30,m_PP=mu_S-mu_D; variances v_D=10.8^2, v_PP=17.6^2+10.8^2-2*0.79*17.6*10.8; cov(D,PP)=0.79*17.6*10.8-10.8^2. Lognormal latent SDs sqrt(log(1+v/m^2)); latent correlation log(1+cov/(m_D*m_PP))/(l_D*l_PP).

requested_analyses.interpretation: BMI coefficient in mmHg per5; conditional slope3.75 anchors positive cross-sectional association. Requested projection may differ because age curvature and age-sex interaction are omitted by analysis.
requested_analyses.unresolved: Target distribution, treatment confounding, BMI functional form and weighted selection unidentified. Finite-cohort sampling variation must remain.

requested_analyses.estimator: equal-weight OLS on same design and rows
requested_analyses.interpretation: BMI coefficient in mmHg per5; conditional slope2.35 not an intervention effect or forced realized coefficient.
requested_analyses.unresolved: Same dependencies plus DBP age nonlinearity.

requested_analyses.estimator: Pearson correlation of paired centered residuals from the specified two OLS models
requested_analyses.interpretation: 0.79 is an assumed conditional correlation informed by source age/BMI residual algebra, not source raw correlation. Omitted age curvature/interactions and finite samples can make actual projection-residual correlation differ.
requested_analyses.unresolved: No direct published task-population residual correlation. Sex adjustment and transport uncertainty, measurement aggregation and treatment mixture not identified.
